title: Study library
summary: A course-level flashcard hub preserves the existing spaced-repetition Study branch and provides a separate scored cloze assessment whose questions are filled from a word bank, never falling back to review behavior.

includes: Existing Flashcard mode entry and deck navigation
Existing Study behavior, unchanged and outside this revision
Scored cloze assessment setup, eligibility, history, stats, timed work, resume and result
Word-bank selection into one or more cloze blanks with per-blank scoring
Explicit unavailable, invalid, expired and legacy-session recovery states
excludes: Redesigning or removing the existing Study branch
Reveal-and-rate or SM-2 fallback inside an assessment
Legacy visual design as product authority

actors.label: Learner
capabilities: Choose existing Study or the separate scored cloze assessment
Review due flashcards or a selected deck
Start, pause or resume a persisted study session
Configure and complete a scored cloze assessment using a word bank
Inspect results and continue into recommended study

actors.label: StarCi Academy platform
capabilities: Expose due work, mastery and resumable work
Persist and restore review sessions and cloze-valid assessment sessions
Reject non-cloze cards from assessment playability and never substitute review behavior
Record progress and completion without changing contract semantics

rules.statement: Existing Study and the scored cloze assessment are explicit sibling modes and never collapse into one ambiguous session.
A review or quiz session is persisted before navigation to focused work.
Live work restores the persisted session identity, card order and acknowledged progress.
Leaving unfinished Study or Quick quiz work preserves resumability; finishing early requires confirmation and reports only completed work.
A live session route represents in-progress work and a dedicated result route represents completed work.
Invalid, missing or expired sessions recover to a safe setup or overview with an explanation.
Study scheduling and route identity remain unchanged; assessment playability requires cloze-valid cards and scoring remains correct blanks over total positive blanks.
Results prioritize weak-topic and contextual next-study actions over decorative celebration.
Every remote-data surface exposes pending, ready, empty, failed and retry or recovery behavior.
Foundation browsing supports pagination and can settle as pending, ready, empty, failed or partial.
An assessment question is playable only when its card contains at least one valid cloze blank.
Every assessment blank is filled by selecting a term from the provided word bank; the learner may revise unchecked choices.
Assessment mode never falls back to answer reveal, self-reported recall rating or SM-2 review behavior.
When the selected scope cannot supply enough cloze-valid questions, starting is blocked with an explicit eligible-count explanation.
Each scored question has totalBlanks greater than zero; coverage is derived from correctBlanks divided by totalBlanks and cannot be fabricated by the client.
A pre-existing mixed or malformed assessment session cannot continue through review fallback; it recovers to setup without producing a scored assessment completion.
The existing Study branch is neither redesigned nor removed by this revision.

acceptance.statement: Flashcard, foundation and mind-map routes mount their declared study surfaces.
Starting a review persists a resumable session for the selected deck and card order.
Foundation queries return a paginated list for the selected category.
Flashcard entry keeps existing Study separate from the scored cloze assessment and preserves route identity.
Study can start from due work or a selected deck and can restrict a deck run to due cards when available.
Study persists before focused work, restores acknowledged progress, supports answer reveal and four recall ratings, and routes completion to a dedicated result.
The assessment exposes Begin, History and Stats, shows eligible cloze-question availability, and persists only a fully playable run.
The assessment restores a valid cloze-only unfinished run and safely recovers from invalid, expired, malformed or legacy mixed-card identity.
Study and assessment both preserve acknowledged work on safe leave, but only Study exposes recall ratings and scheduling behavior.
Study results retain scheduling and grade evidence; assessment results expose correct and total blanks, coverage, XP and per-question outcomes.
Every remote-data surface exposes loading, ready, empty, failed and retry or recovery behavior.
The revision preserves Study behavior, scheduling, access gates and route identity while tightening assessment playability to cloze-valid cards and rejecting zero-blank outcomes.
Every persisted assessment card has at least one valid cloze blank and every scored outcome has totalBlanks greater than zero.
Each assessment question presents blanks and a word bank, permits unchecked choice revision, and checks selections before showing the solution.
No assessment state exposes reveal-and-rate, Again/Hard/Good/Easy or any SM-2 fallback.
Insufficient eligible questions block start with an explicit explanation rather than silently drawing ordinary flashcards.
A client-supplied non-cloze card or zero-blank result is rejected by backend-owned validation.
The existing Study branch is regression-proven unchanged.

unknowns.question: Is the learner ever allowed to edit the course mind map?
unknowns.impact: The current route proves a viewing surface only, so prototypes must not invent authoring controls.

unknowns.question: How many cards in each live course are currently cloze eligible?
unknowns.impact: This does not change the assessment contract, but rollout must measure it because low coverage produces an explicit unavailable state.

evidence.claim: The flashcard review route mounts the review catalog for a course.
The review page exposes due/deck counts, statistics, start/resume actions and settled states.
The foundations route mounts the course foundation library.
The foundation library defines search, pagination, categories, enrollment recovery and pending/ready/empty/failed/partial states.
The course mind-map route mounts CourseMindMapPage.
The guarded mutation persists a resumable flashcard review session for a deck and card order.
The foundations query lists paginated foundations for a category.
The owner authorized refreshing study-library and practice-assessment to current routed source heads before continuing the four-layout design set.
The owner approved redesigning the complete StarCi Academy flashcard UX journey while preserving existing business and backend contracts.
The owner approved the expanded complete flashcard business model with explicit Study and Quick quiz branches, resumable focused sessions, dedicated results and recovery states.

The declared legacy StarCi Academy flashcard manifest evidences the complete Study and Quick quiz journey shape but is reference-only and does not override current routed frontend or backend contracts.
The product owner confirmed that Quiz is a scored examination in which learners select words to fill blanks, and that the existing Study branch was not requested for redesign in this revision.
Current frontend contains word-bank cloze behavior but selects and marks quiz eligibility without cloze filtering and falls back to review-like reveal/rating when cloze is missing.
Current backend persists correctBlanks and totalBlanks for quiz outcomes and currently treats zero-blank outcomes as zero contribution rather than rejecting them.
The attached current UI screenshots show a generic Trắc nghiệm setup whose framing does not disclose the word-bank cloze examination contract.
